editorial:
Imagine you are listening to a late-night radio show when a crazy caller starts talking about a family of killers. That is exactly how this wild ride starts. You get to follow a radio host who finds himself in the wrong place at the wrong time, while a tough old Marshal is on a mission to wipe out the cannibal family for good. Unlike the first movie, which felt like a nightmare, this one feels more like a dark comedy. It is loud, messy, and has a lot of heart, making it feel more like a fun party than a scary trip.

You will love how the movie balances the gore with some really funny moments. The acting is campy and over-the-top, which actually makes it more entertaining. Some parts might feel a bit slow, but the payoff is worth it. If you love old-school slashers, you should definitely check this out. It looks great if you can find the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection, but renting it on Apple TV is a quick way to enjoy the madness. Just make sure you have some snacks ready for the crazy action scenes.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a huge showdown at the family house. After a lot of fighting and screaming, the Marshal finally manages to take down the cannibal family. Leatherface gets caught in a trap and is defeated, and the house is basically destroyed. It wraps up the story by showing that the nightmare is finally over, as the survivors escape the woods and the killers are stopped once and for all.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s horror and dark humor
